context.exploration_scope: Judged PHASE-SSI-S17's PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_ONLY capability Principle for adoption: re-verified both evidence records fresh, re-ran the final duplication/conflict check, and re-verified the statement's scope against the freshly re-derived evidence

problem: PHASE-SSI-S17 drafted a scope-bounded Principle statement and recorded it as a promotion candidate, but adoption is a further, distinct decision that required an independent re-derivation of the same evidence and re-check of the same scope claim in this phase, not merely carrying S17s own verdict forward.

decision.decision_summary: Fresh recompute reproduces the same 2 content-grounded evidence records: true. Real linkage: true. Duplicate/conflict: false. Statement scope-bounded: true. 0 CI wiring, 0 automatic policy, 0 automatic execution, 0 real project modifications. Verdict: RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED.

action.action_summary: Recomputed the content-grounded cap_dataset_management evidence group from scratch; re-ran the E12/E23/E33+S-series/S1/S4 duplication-and-conflict check; re-verified the S17 statement contains no unbounded quantifier and every numeric claim matches the fresh recount; recorded RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED on success.

evidence.evidence_detail: final_state=RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED, evidence_matches_fresh_recompute=true, scope_bounded=true, regression_all_passed=true, dangling=0, duplicates=0

result.note: Second Principle adopted as RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED (cap_dataset_management-scoped) alongside the first (goal_production_runtime-scoped from S4) -- neither CI-wired, neither auto-policy-applied, neither auto-executed.

cause.root_cause_summary: Adoption is the point where a Principle stops being a draft and starts being something future phases could cite as settled -- re-deriving its evidence and re-checking its scope claim independently in this phase, rather than trusting S17s own computation, is what keeps that step from being a rubber stamp.

lesson: A second, independently-derived Principle (capability-scoped) now coexists with the first (goal-scoped) -- both RECORDED_NOT_ENFORCED, both reached through the same disciplined signal->validation->promotion->adoption arc, which is itself evidence that the arc generalizes across different relationship axes (goal+kind vs capability), not just the one case it was first built around.
